title: Minimum cuts are closed under union and intersection
statement: Let $N$ be a network with a single source $x$ and a single sink $y$, and recall that a cut is determined by a vertex set $S$ with $x \in S$ and $y \notin S$, its capacity being $\sum_{u \in S}\sum_{v \notin S} c(u,v)$; a cut is a minimum cut if no cut has strictly smaller capacity. If the cuts determined by vertex sets $S$ and $T$ are both minimum cuts of $N$, then the cuts determined by $S \cup T$ and by $S \cap T$ are also minimum cuts of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a network (single source x, single sink y)
